children: Designer Brands Inc. reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue largely steady versus the year-ago quarter and improved profitability: revenue of $730.6M, net income of $17.6M and diluted EPS of $0.31.
Revenue was $730.6M for Q2 2026, down from $739.8M in the year‑ago quarter (1.2% YoY).
Net income attributable to Designer Brands Inc. was $17.6M for Q2 2026, up from $10.5M in the year‑ago quarter (66.7% YoY).
Diluted earnings per share was $0.31 for Q2 2026, up from $0.21 in the year‑ago quarter (47.6% YoY).
Net sales were largely flat year-to-date; Q2 sales declined 1.2% versus prior year driven by weakness in Retail comparable sales.
Brand portfolio momentum continued, with brand portfolio growth of 17.9% in Q2 and expansions in wholesale and Topo helping offset Retail traffic declines.
Gross margin expanded sharply to 50.0% in Q2, aided by $35.5M of IEEPA tariff recoveries which reduced cost of goods sold.
Management is executing inventory alignment, focusing marketing, remodeling and expanding stores, and diversifying sourcing to mitigate tariff and demand impacts.
Operating cash improved materially year-to-date, supporting ongoing store investments and working capital needs.
